tutorial.welcome: Welcome! The goal is to get rid of all your cards by putting them on the table. There are no turns: everyone plays at the same time, whenever they like. Let's play a short practice game against the Teacher.
tutorial.screen: Your cards are at the bottom and the table is in the middle. At the top are the players, with how many cards each one holds, and the deck.
tutorial.draw: When you can't play, take a card from the deck in the table's corner. Tap the deck (or {draw}).
tutorial.open: Before you can play anything else, you must open: put down a run of at least 3 cards of one suit in order, without jokers. Tap 4♥, 5♥ and 6♥, then tap {open}.
tutorial.teacher: The Teacher opened with a run of diamonds and put down a set: 3 or 4 cards of the same rank, all in different suits. New cards flash, with the name of who played them.
tutorial.add: You can add cards to any pile on the table, yours or anyone's. Tap 7♥, then tap your run of hearts. Your move opens at the bottom, where ✓ means a pile is valid. Tap {done}. In a real game you have 15 seconds to finish a move; here you have more time.
tutorial.joker: A joker can stand in for any card. Make a new pile from your hand: tap Q♠, K♠ and the joker, tap {new_pile}, then tap {done}.
tutorial.split: You can also split a pile. Your 3♦ belongs in the Teacher's run A♦–6♦. Tap that run to take it into your move. There, tap 4♦ and then {split}: you get A♦ 2♦ 3♦ and 4♦ 5♦ 6♦. Tap your 3♦, tap ＋ next to 4♦ 5♦ 6♦, then tap {done}.
tutorial.locked: While someone is changing a pile, it's greyed out with their name, and nobody else can touch it until they're done. Right now the Teacher is using your run of hearts.
tutorial.take: You can also take cards from any pile, as long as what's left is still a run or a set. Tap the set of 9s. In your move tap 9♣, then 8♣ and 10♣ in your hand, and tap {new_pile}. Tap {done}, and you're out of cards!
tutorial.outro: You were the first to get rid of all your cards. In a real game, play goes on until only one player still has cards, and the order in which everyone finishes is the result. You can play with up to 8 people, and add CPU players in the lobby. Have fun!

gin.your_turn_draw: Your turn: tap the deck, or take a card from the discard pile.

gin.rules_goal: Put cards on the table in melds to score points. After a round in which someone has 500 points or more, the highest score wins.
gin.rules_melds: A meld is a run (3 or more cards of one suit in a row; the ace goes low, A-2-3, or high, Q-K-A, never round the corner) or a set (3 or 4 cards of the same rank). A joker stands in for any card and stays on the table once played.
gin.rules_draw: Draw: take the top card of the deck or of the discard pile. You can also take a deeper card of the discard pile with all the cards above it, but only if you put that card on the table this turn.
gin.rules_play: Play: lay down melds from your hand, and add cards to any meld on the table, yours or anyone's. The points for each card go to whoever put it down.
gin.rules_discard: Discard one card to end your turn. You can't discard the card you just took from the discard pile, and you always need a card left to discard.
gin.rules_end: When someone discards their last card, the round ends. Everyone scores their cards on the table minus the cards still in their hand.
gin.rules_values: Card values: joker 25, ace 15 (5 at the start of a run, A-2-3), K Q J 10 are 10, 2 to 9 are 5.
gin.rules_stock: When the deck runs out, the discard pile is shuffled into a new one. If it runs out again with no card played in between, the round ends.
event.stock_out: The deck ran out again: the round is over.
error.just_picked: You can't discard the card you just took from the discard pile.
error.must_play: The card you took from deep in the discard pile has to go on the table first.
error.cant_play_card: You can only take that card if you can put it on the table this turn.
error.keep_one: Keep a card to discard at the end of your turn.
gin_tutorial.welcome: Welcome to Gin! Players take turns. The goal is to put your cards on the table in melds: each card there scores its points for you, and cards left in your hand count against you. Let's play a short round against the Teacher.
gin_tutorial.screen: At the top are the players, with their cards and scores; the one whose turn it is has a yellow ring. On the table are the melds, and below them the discard pile and the deck.
gin_tutorial.draw: It's your turn. Every turn starts with drawing a card: tap the deck.
gin_tutorial.meld: You have 5♥ 6♥ 7♥: a run, 3 cards of one suit in a row. Select them and tap {lay_down} to put them on the table.
gin_tutorial.discard: A turn always ends with a discard. Pick a card you don't need: select K♠ and tap {discard}.
gin_tutorial.teacher: Now it's the Teacher's turn: a draw, a set of three 9s (3 or 4 cards of the same rank) and a discard, 4♦.
gin_tutorial.dig: You can take the top card of the discard pile, or a deeper one with every card above it. That card must go on the table in the same turn. Your 8♥ fits your hearts: tap 8♥ in the discard pile, then tap Take.
gin_tutorial.own: You took 8♥, K♠ and 4♦. Now play 8♥: select it and tap your run of hearts to add it.
gin_tutorial.other: You can add cards to anyone's meld, and their points are yours. Select 9♣ and tap the Teacher's 9s.
gin_tutorial.discard_again: End your turn with a discard: select 4♦ and tap {discard}.
gin_tutorial.teacher_again: The Teacher draws and discards Q♦. When a player is down to one card, everyone is told, so they can get rid of their high cards.
gin_tutorial.draw_last: Your turn again: tap the deck.
gin_tutorial.joker: A joker stands in for any card. Select 10♣, J♣, Q♣ and the joker and tap {lay_down}: the joker is K♣ here, and it's worth 25 points on the table.
gin_tutorial.gin: One card left: discard it and you're out. That's Gin! Select K♠ and tap {discard}.
gin_tutorial.outro: You went out first. You scored the 80 points of your cards on the table; the Teacher scored 15 for the 9s minus 30 for the cards left in hand. In a real game, rounds go on until someone has 500 points, and the highest score wins. Have fun!
